whyItMatters: python only pins the peer when a host-key policy other than the permissive one is installed.
actions: Load a known-hosts file and reject unknown keys (client.load_system_host_keys() followed by RejectPolicy()).
Ship the pinned key with the deployment so first use is already verified.
verification: Rescan shows no permissive host-key policy and the pinned known-hosts file is referenced.
